# Any Provider Will Do {#sec-any-provider}

::: {.callout-note}
## Skeleton

Kills: "I'm locked into one vendor" — OpenAI-compatible endpoints are
a common language.

Installs: the three environment variables, local Ollama for free and
private runs, `HANDS_ON_AI_CACHE` for reproducible classroom reruns.
Working build: the same script run against two providers with no code
change.
:::
